anti_dalal.timeline_en: 30 working days (Under Punjab Right to Service RTS Act)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule_hi: सेवा केंद्र पर आवेदन के तुरंत बाद 16 अंकों की RTS ट्रैकिंग रसीद ज़रूर लें। बिना रसीद कोई अतिरिक्त राशि न दें।
anti_dalal.receipt_rule_en: Collect 16-digit RTS tracking receipt immediately from Sewa Kendra.
anti_dalal.official_fee: ₹0 (Application is completely free by Punjab Government)
anti_dalal.receipt_rule: Collect 16-digit RTS tracking receipt immediately from Sewa Kendra.
anti_dalal.middleman_warning: Never pay agents/middlemen promising guaranteed approval or faster clearance. Benefits are disbursed strictly via DBT / official portals.
